What is new in %1$s
View change history

1.0 ? first production release

• Guided setup for engines and folders.
• Google Play update checks and optional daily checks.
• Change history shown once per installed version.
• Mod search and automatic refresh after installation.
• Correct alternative destinations for Plus and P-Slice.
• API compatibility checks using verified game rules; unknown builds are clearly marked.
• ZIP path, duplicate, size and nesting checks.
• Temporary installation folders and separate copies for repeated names.
• Copy failures no longer count as a successful move.
• Folder grants can be released from Settings.
? Complete interface translations in 10 language variants, including Japanese, Korean and simplified/traditional Chinese.
? Localized metadata editor and improved folder guides.
? SHA-256 read-back verification of installed files.

0.7 beta

• Separate screens and installation utilities.
• Engine detection and game/folder shortcuts.
• Improved ZIP root detection.
